name: Stage 25: Lundsjön to Vallmotorp
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 25, Lundsjön to Vallmotorp.
utilities: Parking is possible near the Lundsjön start and at/near Vallmotorp, but the Lundsjön parking is unmapped/forest-road context and Vallmotorp parking is approximate; check local signs before leaving a car.

Myrgryten is the main on-stage overnight/rest node with shelter, dry toilet, fireplace/grill, bench/rest context and lake access. Do not assume bins or firewood. The nearby locked cabin/simple cabin and charcoal hut should be treated as bookable/organized or cultural context, not as guaranteed public shelters.
No shop or restaurant was verified directly on stage 25. Better services are in Katrineholm or by continuing toward Lövåsen on stage 26.

Public transport is weak at both endpoints. Naturkartan found no useful nearby stops for the stage page; use Sörmlandstrafiken live planning, and treat Bie/Ramsta/Björkhaga/Oxlångstorp-style rural stops and K10 complementary traffic as date-dependent access options with extra road walking or advance booking before 16:00 the weekday before travel where required.
waterSources: Official water points are the natural spring about 1 km west of Myrgryten and the spring-fed tap at Mellan-Malmen. Sörmlandsleden does not test or guarantee availability/quality, and hiker reports have found dry/no-flow conditions in this area, so treat/filter and carry enough backup.

The Mellan-Malmen tap is the best-triangulated refill: official coordinate, OSM spring close by, Vardagstur 2022 use, and a 2025 official-page comment reporting fresh usable water. Older Ledsyn/Staffan Sandberg reports still mean it should not be treated as guaranteed.

A May 2025 through-hiker report in the neighbouring 23-27 chain mentioned frog-contaminated and effectively dry spring experiences after the Myrgryten area, without precisely pinning them to Mellan-Malmen. Use it as a carry-extra-water warning rather than as proof that the official Mellan-Malmen tap was dry.
Lake water from Ljusgryten, Myrgryten and Mellan-Malmen is natural/untested; use only with treatment and do not treat bathing access as potable water.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official/Naturkartan distance is 9 km. OSM relation 3925355 is the matching stage relation but has a stale/rounded 10 km distance tag; OSM relation geometry is about 8.7 km and local generated geometry about 8.5 km. Use official 9 km as canonical.

Draw Stage 25 as the continuous Lundsjön-Vallmotorp stage. Local geometry chains exactly from Stage 24 and to Stage 26; OSM relation 3925355 currently orders members Vallmotorp-Lundsjön, so reverse it if importing directly. Keep the official Vigors kyrka 3 km round loop/side route separate, even where it shares geometry, and keep Stage 24 and Stage 26 as their own connected stages.

Route character: relatively easy to easy-moderate forest/lake stage, with roots/rocks, some elevation, occasional clear-cut/rocky forest reports, and limited flat rest spots between facilities. Highlights include the Vigors kyrka boulders, Ljusgryten fishing lake, Myrgryten shelter/lake, Gölstugruvorna mine remains/open-air church, and Mellan-Malmen rest/bathing.

Official page showed no current fault reports during the 2026-04-27 research pass. Recent 2025 comments describe the stage as maintained, not crowded, dog-friendly, easy, pleasant, well kept and with good Mellan-Malmen water, but one 2025 comment said the Myrgryten toilet needed emptying.

Use only existing fireplaces and check current Katrineholm/VSR/Södermanland fire rules before lighting anything. VSR reported no formal fire ban during the 2026-04-27 pass but dry/high-fire-risk conditions, so avoid fires in nature where possible. Shelters do not guarantee firewood or rubbish service.

No stage-specific nature-reserve camping restriction was found. Use normal allemansrätten low-impact tenting principles, avoid private plots around Mellan-Malmen, and prefer durable ground near established rest/overnight areas.
Warm-season user comments mention possible algae/slippery gubbslem conditions at Myrgryten; treat as a bathing comfort/irritation caveat, not a formal closure.

facilities.name: Lundsjön stage start
facilities.description: Official stage start by the road south of Lundsjön. Sörmlandsleden says parking is possible about 100 m southwest by a forest road; stage 24 also mentions parking north/former gravel-pit context nearby, so exact parking should be checked locally.

facilities.name: Lundsjön approximate forest-road parking
facilities.description: Approximate parking context inferred from the official stage-25 note about parking about 100 m southwest by a forest road. Low confidence; use local signs and do not block forest access.

facilities.name: Vigors kyrka boulders
facilities.description: Large boulder/folklore site reached early from the stage and tied to the separate official 3 km Vigors kyrka round loop. OSM names the loop Vigors kyrko, likely a typo; official name is Vigors kyrka.

facilities.name: Ljusgryten fishing lake
facilities.description: Managed stocked fishing lake with jetties/rest context. Fishing requires current permit via Forssjö Fiskevårdsförening and local sources list fishing hours 05:00-22:00; lake water is not potable without treatment.

facilities.name: Ljusgryten fishing and grill caveat
facilities.description: Naturkartan/local sources describe shelters and designated grill places around Ljusgryten, but no toilet, bin, tap or trail-operated service was verified. Use only signed fireplaces, read the fishing board/permit terms, and follow current fire rules.

facilities.name: Myrgryten shelter
facilities.description: Official wind shelter and main overnight/rest node by Myrgryten, using the more precise OSM shelter pin. Free, first-come, shared, cannot be booked, and no firewood or bin guarantee.

facilities.name: Myrgryten fireplace/grill
facilities.description: Prepared fireplace/grill at the shelter cluster. Use only when current fire rules allow, never on rock, and never make new fire scars; no firewood guarantee.

facilities.name: Myrgryten dry toilet
facilities.description: Official dry toilet at/near Myrgryten shelter. A 2025 user comment reported it needed emptying then, so verify on arrival.

facilities.name: Myrgryten lake rest and swim
facilities.description: Lake/rest context near the shelter. Warm-season comments mention possible slippery algae/gubbslem irritation; lake water is not potable without treatment.

facilities.name: Myrgryten locked cabin and charcoal hut context
facilities.description: Sörmlandsleden mentions a locked simple overnight cabin on the south shore and a nearby charcoal hut with bunks; use/contact details are separate from the public wind shelter and should not be treated as guaranteed open access.

facilities.name: Spring west of Myrgryten
facilities.description: Official natural source about 1 km west of Myrgryten. Independent confirmation is limited and dry/no-flow reports exist for stage water generally; filter/boil/treat and carry backup.

facilities.name: Gölstugruvorna and open-air church
facilities.description: Mapped/placename heritage context for mine remains, seven water-filled mine holes, waste-rock heaps and an open-air church. Stay outside fences, keep children/dogs close, avoid spoil/shaft edges, and do not disturb remains.

facilities.name: Gölstugruvorna mine-hole caution
facilities.description: Approximate wider mine-hazard context: old water-filled shafts/spoil heaps can be deep, slippery or fenced. Stay on marked paths and do not climb into shafts.

facilities.name: Mellan-Malmen spring-fed tap
facilities.description: Official tap where water runs by gravity from a cold spring; OSM has a spring at essentially the same location, Vardagstur used it in 2022, and a 2025 comment reported good fresh water. Older reports found no water/dry spring, and quality is not guaranteed/tested.

facilities.name: Mellan-Malmen rest and bathing
facilities.description: Official good rest and bathing place just south of the water point. Natural lake water only.

facilities.name: Mellan-Malmen mapped toilet/firepit/parking cluster
facilities.description: OSM maps a firepit, bucket-toilet-like feature with drinking_water=no, and gravel parking west of the official water point, but Sörmlandsleden does not list these as stage facilities. Treat as OSM-confirmed context and field-check before relying on them.

facilities.name: Vallmotorp endpoint
facilities.description: Stage endpoint and stage-26 junction. Official text says parking is possible at Vallmotorp; stage 26 places parking about 300 m north, so verify local signs.

facilities.name: Vallmotorp parking context
facilities.description: Parking context from the stage-26 start area, about 300 m north of Vallmotorp. Use as approximate access, not a guaranteed lot capacity.

facilities.name: Häggsjön shelter continuation
facilities.description: Useful continuation service on stage 26 if walking beyond Vallmotorp: shelter/toilet/jetty/rest context. Not part of core stage 25.

facilities.name: Bie rural transit context
facilities.description: Possible public-transport approach west of Lundsjön, roughly 4 km from the route and not on-stage. Verify current Sörmlandstrafiken routes and times before using.

facilities.name: Björkhaga rural transit context
facilities.description: Rural bus context west/southwest of Vallmotorp, just over 2 km from the route. Not at the trailhead; requires road walking and current timetable verification.

facilities.name: No verified Stage 25 bins
facilities.description: No rubbish-bin point was verified on Stage 25. Sörmlandsleden shelters generally do not provide bins; pack out all waste.
